description: This file contains the implementation of the Point of Sale module for an Odoo (OpenERP) system, including classes for POS orders, order lines, payments, and related reports, with methods for handling order processing, invoicing, accounting entries, and stock movements.

classes.name: pos_config_journal
classes.description: Configuration class for POS journal settings.

classes.name: pos_order
classes.description: Main class representing a POS order, including methods for order lifecycle, invoicing, accounting, and stock management.

classes.name: pos_order_line
classes.description: Represents individual lines within a POS order, including product selection, quantity, and pricing.

classes.name: pos_payment
classes.description: Handles payments associated with POS orders, including payment method and amount.

classes.name: report_transaction_pos
classes.description: Database view class for reporting POS transactions.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes a POS order if it is in draft state.

methods.name: onchange_partner_pricelist
methods.description: Updates the pricelist based on the selected partner.

methods.name: _amount_total
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of the order including taxes.

methods.name: _amount_tax
methods.description: Calculates the total tax for the order.

methods.name: _total_payment
methods.description: Calculates the total amount paid.

methods.name: _total_return
methods.description: Calculates the total amount returned.

methods.name: payment_get
methods.description: Retrieves payment IDs associated with an order.

methods.name: _sale_journal_get
methods.description: Gets the default sale journal.

methods.name: _receivable_get
methods.description: Gets the default receivable account.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates a POS order with default values.

methods.name: test_order_lines
methods.description: Validates that the order has order lines before processing.

methods.name: dummy_button
methods.description: Placeholder method for custom button actions.

methods.name: test_paid
methods.description: Checks if the order is fully paid.

methods.name: _get_qty_differences
methods.description: Detects changes in product quantities between current order and previous picking.

methods.name: _split_picking
methods.description: Splits stock pickings if product quantities are modified.

methods.name: create_picking
methods.description: Creates and confirms stock pickings for the order.

methods.name: set_to_draft
methods.description: Resets order state to draft and reinitializes workflow.

methods.name: cancel_order
methods.description: Cancels an order by creating an inverted stock picking.

methods.name: add_payment
methods.description: Adds a payment to an order.

methods.name: add_product
methods.description: Adds a product to an order as a new line.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Creates a refund copy of an order with negative quantities.

methods.name: invoice_action_done
methods.description: Creates and validates invoice for a paid order.

methods.name: action_invoice
methods.description: Generates invoice(s) from the order.

methods.name: create_account_move
methods.description: Creates accounting entries for the order, including taxes and revenue.

methods.name: action_paid
methods.description: Marks order as paid and creates stock pickings.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the order and associated stock pickings.

methods.name: action_done
methods.description: Finalizes the order by creating accounting entries.

methods.name: _amount_line
methods.description: Calculates subtotal for an order line.

methods.name: price_by_product
methods.description: Retrieves the price for a product based on the pricelist.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Updates the unit price when product is changed.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new order line, validating product presence.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates an order line, validating product presence.

methods.name: _scan_product
methods.description: Processes barcode scan to add or update product in order.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Allows deletion of order lines only in draft or canceled state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new POS payment record.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates a POS payment record.
